children.name: Month grid always renders 42 cells (6 full weeks) so grid height never jumps between months. Range selection: first click sets start, second sets end, a third click starts a new range; clicking before the current start moves the start instead of erroring. 836:4005.description: Captures a single line (or length-constrained block) of user-entered text for form submission, search, or filtering. 4 types (Outlined/Filled/Borderless/Inline) x 3 sizes x 5 baked states (Default/Hover/Focus/Disabled/Error). Read-only, Warning, Success and Loading are not baked as separate variants — apply them by combining with component properties / manual overrides per the approved playbook (component budget: 60 baked variants, kept under the 80-variant ceiling).
